points.description: States that sizeof returns the size of its operand (a type or variable/expression) in bytes.
points.partial_credit: 2 marks if it says only 'the size' of a variable/type without bytes, or is vague (e.g. 'memory used') without naming bytes.

points.description: Identifies that the size is of its operand, i.e. the type or variable/expression given to sizeof.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying sizeof gives the size in bytes of the variable or type it is applied to, in any wording. Part marks if the answer says 'size' or 'memory' but omits bytes, or is vague about what is measured. No marks if it describes something else, such as the value stored, the number of elements, or string length.
